name: ipinyou-landscape-ctx
source: iPinYou RTB dataset, season 2; trained on won/lost outcomes of log-uniform exploration bids only
form: P(win | x, b) = sigmoid(a(x) + beta(x) * ln b); a(x) = intercept + weights + tags; beta(x) = max(slope.base + slope.advertiser + slope.adexchange, slope_floor)

bidding.rule: value = level * pCTR / mean_pctr; bid = argmax_b (value - b) * P(win | x, b)
